verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated OpenTelemetry docs section describing OTLP ingestion support (via Datadog Agent OTLP ingest or direct OTLP intake), so the axis is clearly delivered at a first-party docs level. However, evidence lacks independent hands-on corroboration of OTLP send paths, edge cases, or limitations reported by real users. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of OTLP ingestion working end-to-end, details on unsupported OTel signals or configuration friction.
